build_sim_siam_model: build a SimSiam model with a base encoder, feature dimension 2048, and predictor dimension 512
create_sim_siam_encoder: create a SimSiam encoder that transforms image views into feature vectors of dimension 2048
create_sim_siam_predictor: create a 2-layer predictor that maps feature vectors through a hidden dimension of 512
run_sim_siam_forward: run the SimSiam forward pass on two image views to get predictors and detached targets
review_sim_siam_projector: review the 3-layer projector built into the SimSiam encoder for self-supervised representation learning
